profile.headline: Staff Embedded Software Engineer at Symbotic
profile.summary:
I was raised in the beautiful city of San Diego, where my early curiosity for how things work eventually led me to pursue a degree in Robotics Engineering at Worcester Polytechnic Institute (WPI), graduating in 2014. Since then, I’ve built a career at the intersection of innovation and automation—starting at HighRes Biosolutions and continuing at Symbotic, where I’ve been contributing to cutting-edge robotics solutions for nearly a decade.

Outside of work, I’m passionate about being creative and technical. Whether I’m crafting soundscapes with synthesizers, building with wood, or cultivating life in the garden, I find joy in making things that are both functional and expressive. My life blends technical precision with artistic exploration, and I’m always looking for new ways to grow, build, and connect.

positions.title: Interim Manager
positions.description:
During the time between team managers I acted as interim manager for my software team. I did all non-HR related managing tasks for the team.
-Discussed Priorities with upper management
-Delegated work to team members, and made sure the work was in line with team priorities
-Went to internal meetings as the representative of the SAS team
-Worked as a single point of contact for anyone who needed help/work from the team

positions.title: Advanced Embedded Engineer
positions.description: Skills: WindRiver · IAR Embedded Workbench · GitHub · Gitlab · Version Control

positions.title: Embedded Engineer
positions.description: Writing and maintaining code for the Safe Access Software team at Symbotic. This code keeps users safe by managing access to areas where the mobile robotic platform operates. Using Git we write code in C++, perform unit testing, do code reviews, and deploy changes. Working with a multithreaded application in VxWorks platform. Additionally perform customer facing support for the software over phone and instant messaging.

positions.title: Electrical Test Engineer
positions.description: Operated in the Manufacturing group to define, design, and implement new testing. Focused on the mobile robot that Symbotic designed. Maintained manufacturing testing software and procedures.

positions.title: Software Automation Engineer
positions.description: Worked with Clients from around the world to implement automated laboratory procedures. This process went all the way from system setup and programming to installation and training on site with customers. Programming the systems involved creating custom robot code for each system and implementing drivers in C#.

positions.title: Academic Technology Center Member
positions.description: Worked with Students, Teachers, and Faculty to provide any help needed with AV equipment. Worked a front desk interacting with clients face to face to advise and diagnose problems with equipment. Supplied tech support over the phone for on campus systems. Helped support online classrooms to facilitate high quality teaching to students over the internet. Worked in the ATC printing posters for on campus events and many departments at school.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked with a Gumstix Linux computer to develop a system to calculate data loss in flash memory due to unceremonious power loss. This involved programming the Gumstix computer to read characters in and write them to memory, then a transistor circuit would cut power to the computer. Upon reboot the file on the Gumstix would be read and compared to the master file from the server computer.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Robotics Engineering with a Minor in Electrical and Computer Engineering

projects.title: Unified Robotics IV
projects.description: Students of Unified Robotics IV (RBE3002) were divided into teams of three, which were then required to create a that could localize, plan, and execute a motion path. The robot used Robotic Operating System(ROS) to manage the robot operation. Python code was written to allow the robot to use a Hokuyo LiDAR to map surroundings. Code for a Particle filter was written for accurate localization and A* was used to generate paths.

projects.title: Personal Assistive Robot
projects.description: Designed, built, and programmed a modular base platform for assistive care robotics research. The group did research into the needs of people with various disabilities and designed a robot that could serve as a development platform for future years. Final product was a modular, mobile robot using Primesense cameras to perform SLAM.
